Brightwater used 3,315 megalitres = 3,315,000 cubic metres. Millbrook used 2,806 megalitres = 2,806,000 cubic metres.

Difference: 509,000 cubic metres × 142.35 tenge = 72,454,?  
\(509{,}000 \times 142.35 = 72{,}454{,}150\) tenge = 72.45415 million tenge, which rounds to 72.45 million tenge.

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.45

Brightwater used 3,315 megalitres, while Millbrook used 2,806 megalitres. The difference is 509 megalitres = 509,000 cubic metres.

At 142.35 tenge per cubic metre:

509,000 × 142.35 = 72,? 509 × 142.35 = 72,?  
142.35 × 500 = 71,175; × 9 = 1,281.15; total = 72,456.15 thousand tenge = 72.45615 million tenge.

ANSWER: Brightwater | 72.46 million tenge
